fragrances.name: La Vie Est Belle
fragrances.description: A sugary praline and iris gourmand opened by ripe pear and blackcurrant. It is warm, cheerful and very sweet, and a patchouli backbone stops it from going flat.
cons: So popular it can feel generic

fragrances.name: Trésor
fragrances.description: A plush, powdery rose and apricot bouquet softened with heliotrope and vanilla. Romantic and a little retro, it wraps around you like a blush-pink cashmere shawl.

fragrances.name: J'adore
fragrances.description: A luminous bouquet of jasmine, tuberose and lily, softened by juicy pear and melon. It is polished, golden and elegant without effort.
pros: Ideal for weddings and formal days

fragrances.name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
fragrances.description: A soft, dewy peony and rose bouquet with a touch of mandarin and a clean musky finish. Light, sweet-natured and very girlish.

fragrances.name: Hypnotic Poison
fragrances.description: A dark, creamy almond and vanilla scent with hints of coconut and spice. Seductive and a little mysterious, it is best worn after dark.

fragrances.name: Coco Mademoiselle
fragrances.description: Sparkling orange and rose settle into a crisp patchouli and musk base. It feels poised and confident, a modern classic.

fragrances.name: Chance Eau Tendre
fragrances.description: A soft, juicy blend of quince and grapefruit over hyacinth, jasmine and white musk. Airy, sweet-tempered and easy to wear.

fragrances.name: Libre
fragrances.description: A modern take on lavender and orange blossom, grounded in warm vanilla and musk. Bold and chic, with a slightly androgynous edge.

fragrances.name: Black Opium
fragrances.description: A coffee and vanilla gourmand for nighttime, brightened by pear and white flowers. Sweet and energetic, built for going out.

fragrances.name: Sì
fragrances.description: A lush blackcurrant chypre over a smooth base of vanilla, patchouli and woods. Grown-up, warm and quietly sensual.

fragrances.name: Acqua di Gioia
fragrances.description: A breezy splash of lemon and mint with watery jasmine over soft woods and a trace of brown sugar. Clean, sunny and energizing.

fragrances.name: Good Girl
fragrances.description: A dramatic tuberose and jasmine accord wrapped in cocoa, tonka, almond and coffee. Sultry, sweet and theatrical.

fragrances.name: Flowerbomb
fragrances.description: A candied burst of jasmine, orchid and rose over a patchouli and musk base. Sweet, glamorous and openly feminine.

fragrances.name: Daisy
fragrances.description: A light, sunny floral of strawberry and violet leaf over soft musk. Playful, fresh and carefree.
cons: May feel too young for some

fragrances.name: Bloom
fragrances.description: Creamy tuberose and jasmine buds lifted by the green, honeyed lilt of Rangoon creeper. Lush and full-bodied, it reads like an armful of freshly cut white flowers.
cons: Heady if you dislike white florals

fragrances.name: Candy
fragrances.description: A velvety caramel and benzoin gourmand under a veil of powdery musk. Indulgent but more refined than you might expect.

fragrances.name: Paradoxe
fragrances.description: Glowing neroli and orange blossom over a warm amber and musk base. Luminous, modern and easy to love.
cons: Can turn sharp on some skin

fragrances.name: Donna Born in Roma
fragrances.description: A triple jasmine accord over bourbon vanilla and smoky guaiac wood. Sleek and warm, made for city nights.

fragrances.name: Alien
fragrances.description: Bright, almost solar jasmine sambac locked onto a warm cashmeran and white amber base. Dense, unmistakable and unusually long-lived.
pros: A little goes a long way

fragrances.name: Angel
fragrances.description: The original modern gourmand: cotton-candy sweetness, red berries and chocolate collide with bitter patchouli. Bold, strange and hard to forget.

fragrances.name: L'Interdit
fragrances.description: A white-floral bouquet of tuberose and orange blossom darkened by earthy patchouli and vetiver. Elegant, with a rebellious streak.

fragrances.name: Her
fragrances.description: A bright burst of mixed berries over soft musk and woods. Juicy, cheerful and made for city days.

fragrances.name: Light Blue
fragrances.description: Crisp Sicilian lemon and green apple over cedar and soft musk. Bright and uncomplicated, it suits long sunny afternoons near the sea.
cons: Fades close to skin within hours

fragrances.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A fresh, powdery rose with peony and lychee over cedar and amber. Graceful, clean and softly romantic.

fragrances.name: Nomade
fragrances.description: A modern chypre that pairs juicy mirabelle plum with oakmoss and warm woods. Confident, grounded and adventurous.

fragrances.name: Scandal
fragrances.description: Golden honey and beeswax poured over gardenia, with a kick of patchouli. Playful, bold and a bit cheeky.

fragrances.name: Olympéa
fragrances.description: A salty vanilla wrapped around creamy woods and a hint of jasmine. Sensual, skin-like and addictive.

fragrances.name: Lady Million
fragrances.description: A loud mix of honey, raspberry and orange blossom over patchouli and amber. Glitzy and made to be noticed.

fragrances.name: For Her Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A sensual musk heart framed by rose and peach and anchored by patchouli and amber. Intimate, grown-up and magnetic.
pros: Moves easily from day to night
